title: Sum of Values at Indices With K Set Bits
summary: Given a 0-indexed integer array nums and an integer k, return the sum of elements in nums where the indices have exactly k set bits in their binary representation.
statement: Given a 0-indexed integer array nums and an integer k, return the sum of elements in nums where the indices have exactly k set bits in their binary representation.
constraints: Use each element’s zero-based array index.
An index qualifies when its binary representation contains exactly k one bits.
Return the sum of values at all qualifying indices.
reference_solution:
def sum_at_k_set_bit_indices(nums,k):
    return sum(value for index,value in enumerate(nums) if index.bit_count()==k)
hints: The selection rule concerns indices, not stored values.
Use integer bit_count on every enumerated index.
Add the corresponding value exactly when the count equals k.
Enumeration considers every index once and the equality test implements the qualification exactly.
editorial: Enumeration considers every index once and the equality test implements the qualification exactly.

tests.explanation: Indices one, two, and four each have one set bit, contributing 10+1+2=13.
Only index three has two set bits, contributing one.
